outlines.outline: A miscopies a tray convention to appear competent and hide losing the parcel. B wants a practical recovery call; A complies with a blame-dispersing report.
Birthday partners need corrected invitations. A copied a returned envelope without understanding the mark. B pins blame to A, so A asks B to join checking while blaming functions.
A and B face window damage. A copies B checking the crack as procedure and avoids responsibility. B supplies successive practical ways to ask the question now.
Partners share a replacement meal. A mistakes folded menu use for session boundaries and hides behind those boundaries. B gives up dessert for an explanation; A redirects again.
